The 1537-game opener archive is the one lanes K, S, T, V and C2 were selected on and S3 is itself a post-hoc restriction fitted on it, so this is a descriptive reused-window measurement, not independent confirmation. Nine nested and correlated arms against three baselines. No rotation window spent.
spread_size_calibration_v1_A1_lattice_sh.plain_summary: The model's stated confidence barely changes with the size of the spread even though its accuracy does. This version reads the cover chance off how games at a similar spread actually finished, then corrects how confident that read is separately for each spread size, learned from earlier seasons. Measured on games with a spread of three points or less against the read that is played today (smooth, with the key-number read on lines of exactly 3 or 7), on seasons the correction never saw.

spread_size_calibration_v1_A1_lattice_sh.classification_evidence: No resolved wrong sign, no zero split-half reliability and no positive control proven able to detect an effect this size, so the only admissible classification is unresolved_below_power.

spread_size_calibration_v1_A5_smooth_slo.notes: MOD-18 lane C3. Opener-graded, paired per game, block bootstrap over (season, week) blocks, 20000 draws, seed 20260817. The recalibration is fitted on 2020-2022 and scored on 2023-2025, so it sees no game from a season it is graded on. The 1537-game opener archive is the one lanes K, S, T, V and C2 were selected on and S3 is itself a post-hoc restriction fitted on it, so this is a descriptive reused-window measurement, not independent confirmation. Nine nested and correlated arms against three baselines. No rotation window spent.
spread_size_calibration_v1_A5_smooth_slo.plain_summary: The model's stated confidence barely changes with the size of the spread even though its accuracy does. This version keeps the usual smooth curve and only dials its confidence up or down by spread size. Measured on games with a spread of ten and a half points or more against the read that is played today (smooth, with the key-number read on lines of exactly 3 or 7), on seasons the correction never saw.

spread_size_calibration_v1_A8_played_slo.plain_summary: The model's stated confidence barely changes with the size of the spread even though its accuracy does. This version keeps every pick on the card exactly as it is and only fixes how confident the page says each pick is, separately for each spread size. Measured on games with a spread of three points or less against the read that is played today (smooth, with the key-number read on lines of exactly 3 or 7), on seasons the correction never saw.
